title: How Does Storyblok Pricing Work in 2026? Seats Decide
summary: Storyblok pricing is based on seat count, not traffic, with solo users free and teams paying from $99 monthly. Find the exact cost for your team.
body_markdown:
## Automating Storyblok Publishing Chores with Activepieces


If the $174 boundary is coming, the automation won't move it in either direction. Activepieces can take over the manual steps that follow a Storyblok publish, across 750 integrations, and it has no effect on which Storyblok plan you pay for.


Do the arithmetic, though, because the chores are real. Every publish tends to carry a small tail of manual work: someone tells the channel, someone kicks off a rebuild, someone updates the record the sales team reads. Each is a minute or two.


Multiplied by every editor and every publish, that's paid hours of copy-and-paste, and it's the one cost in this article that you can cut without negotiating with Storyblok.


### What a Storyblok Publish Webhook Can Trigger


When content is published, Storyblok can send a webhook. Activepieces receives it as the trigger of a workflow, and a run counts as 1 credit however many steps it has, so the three jobs below cost one credit per publish.


From that single event the workflow can branch to three jobs: post a message to Slack, start a rebuild of the site, and sync the entry to a CRM.


Think of a CRM as the customer-records system the sales or support team works from. An editor publishes once and all three follow, so nobody has to remember them.


Take from it that the automation sits beside your Storyblok subscription and doesn't alter what that subscription includes.


Because the trigger is a webhook and the HTTP step reaches anything with an API, a missing connector never stalls you.


Activepieces can generate an integration with AI and add it privately to your own instance, so no vendor release or ticket queue stands between you and the action.


About 60% of its 750 integrations were contributed by the community, a count you can take straight from the open-source monorepo on GitHub, so a fourth or fifth action such as a cache purge or a translation request never touches your seat, role, environment or locale setup.


### What it does not replace


Don't expect Activepieces to change Storyblok's price or unlock plan features. It won't add seats or roles, and it won't create extra environments or locales.


If your team structure pushes you from the $99 plan to the $349 one, a workflow can't move you back down.


It also isn't a substitute for a Storyblok feature you lack. A webhook only reports that something was published.


Approval steps, role permissions and separate environments are Storyblok plan capabilities, and a Slack message saying "ready for review" isn't the same as an enforced review stage.


So treat[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/pricing) as a way to recover editor time, and keep pricing the plan by your team's structure first.


It is a second bill, but a small one: the free plan is $0 with 1,000 credits a month and unlimited flows, and Plus is $20 a month for 10,000 credits.
